resources.string: Looking for FMLAB Emulator on this Wi-Fi…
On the iPhone open FMLAB Emulator and a game. Both phones on the same Wi-Fi. Tap the iPhone to become player 2 (up to 4).
If the iPhone does not appear (some routers block discovery): its address is in iPhone Settings › Wi-Fi › ⓘ.
The game was closed or the Wi-Fi dropped.
Wi-Fi search is not working: use the address.
Leave the game? The other players keep playing.
Tap Update: Android installs it over this version, nothing is lost.
To find your games FMLAB needs access to the phone files: they go in the FMLAB/Giochi folder (or in Download). Saves go in FMLAB/Salvataggi, BIOS in FMLAB/BIOS.
No emulator installed yet: in Emulators install the ones for your consoles.
No games found. Put them in %1$s or in Download (zipped games: unzip them first).
Games are read from %1$s and from Download. No games or BIOS are included or downloaded by FMLAB.

Install only the emulators you need: each one is downloaded from the FMLAB project (libretro cores, open source) and checked by its fingerprint. Android lets them run fast (JIT): N64, Dreamcast, 3DS and GameCube work on powerful phones.
The list of emulators could not be loaded: check the connection and come back.
Resolution of the 3D (PSP, DS, N64, PlayStation). Original is the lightest; Enhanced doubles it (PSP 960×544); Maximum triples it (PSP 1440×816), for the TV and powerful phones.
Sharp keeps the pixels square, for 2D games; Smooth blends them. The 3D is always smooth.
TV Lines draws the lines of an old television; LCD Grid the grid of a Game Boy screen.
Original keeps the true shape; 16:9 fills modern screens; Fill stretches to the whole screen.
Your folders: %1$s/Giochi, Salvataggi, BIOS. They stay even if you uninstall the app.
The game runs but shows no picture

If the game is DECRYPTED it should start: try Azahar (Emulators › Nintendo 3DS Azahar), more recent than Citra. If it is ENCRYPTED it needs the keys of your own 3DS: put keys.txt / aes_keys.txt in FMLAB/BIOS/azahar/sysdata (read the README there). Also check the phone is powerful enough (Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer is best).
This emulator draws on the graphics chip: if the phone does not support what it needs, the picture stays black. Try Quality: Original in Settings, and check the messages below.
The game file may be damaged or for another console, or a BIOS is missing in FMLAB/BIOS.
Extracting the game (only the first time)… %1$d%%
The .zip could not be extracted (damaged, protected by a password, or not enough space).
